# Damp in the boxes again

Lost the best part of Saturday to AWS-03 and AWS-09 this weekend, and I am still
finding silica packets in my coat pockets from it. Went up to do the usual battery
round and only opened the lids at all because the numbers coming off AWS-03 had been
looking odd for a few days. Wish I hadn't bothered looking, in a way, because now I
can't stop noticing it everywhere I go.

AWS-03 first. Cracked the lid and there was a good centimetre of water sitting in the
bottom tray, the plywood mount gone soft and grey where it had clearly been sitting
in it a while. The inside of the lid was fogged up like a car windscreen on a cold
morning, with drops actually running down and pooling on the electronics tray
underneath. Everything still worked, which surprised me, but the terminal block had
gone a nasty greenish colour and one of the screw heads crumbled the moment I put a
screwdriver to it.

Dried it out with a roll of kitchen paper I had left over from lunch, propped the lid
open with a stick for twenty minutes while I did the next station along, then packed
it back up with three fresh sachets out of the bag. Wrote AWS-03 on the whiteboard
when I got back down so someone remembers to check it again in a couple of weeks
rather than it getting left another six months like last time.

AWS-09 wasn't as bad but had the same fog on the lid, and a damp sock's worth of
water low down near where the cable comes in. My guess is that one is coming in round
the cable rather than through the lid seal, going by where the water had ended up,
but it was getting dark by then and I still had the ride back down the valley ahead
of me, so I didn't chase it properly.

Neither of these had thrown anything on the dashboard, which is honestly the part
that bothers me most. You'd only ever catch this by opening the box and having a
look, and nobody's got time to open every box every weekend. I don't have a fix out
of this, just a Saturday's worth of kitchen roll and a note to go back and check both
of them again soon.

## What's going in the bag from now on

Started carrying spare sachets and a cloth on every round after this, alongside the
torch, because there's no way to tell from outside whether a box is bone dry or
swimming. Also started actually writing down which boxes get opened on a given
weekend, since before this I couldn't have told you when AWS-03 was last looked at.

## Still bugging me

Two boxes wet on the same weekend, neither of them showing anything on the dashboard,
isn't a coincidence I'm comfortable with. Feels like something whoever's doing the
redesign work ought to know about, if they don't already have it on their list.
